breakdown.description: The prompt sets the support slopes to zero under symmetric loading, but a simply supported beam under uniform load still rotates at the supports.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification explicitly states 'The end slopes are not constrained and are to be computed, not assumed zero,' directly correcting the flawed assumption in the incomplete prompt. It then proceeds to compute the slope at x = 0 using the correct simply supported beam formula, yielding a non-zero slope of approximately 1.139 × 10^-3 radians, which aligns with the ground truth treatment of a simply supported beam under UDL where end rotations are free and non-zero.
